metadata.provisional_labels_note: Cases with review_status 'provisional_pending_legal_review' have statutory labels pending qualified legal review. Their labels are unchanged. 'overall_metrics' includes them; 'overall_metrics_excluding_provisional' excludes them.
metadata.review_status_note: 'verified_authoritative' is the original status assigned when the synthetic benchmark was built. No case has a documented review by a qualified legal professional; see label_review_notes in the benchmark file for documented label concerns.
metadata.service_limitations_and_notes: Deterministic BM25 fallback is fully reproducible offline. Google Gemini Live API mode is subject to upstream 503 high-demand / quota limits; fallbacks are recorded separately and never counted as live responses.

retrieval_recall_at_k.numerator: Ground-truth relevant sections in the first k results of BM25LegalRetriever.retrieve(translated narrative, top_k=10)
retrieval_recall_at_k.denominator: Total ground-truth relevant sections across cases in split
retrieval_recall_at_k.limitations: Diagnostic of single-pass global BM25 only. It is NOT the candidate pool used by the service, which uses retrieve_clause_level(max_k=8) and never passes more than 8 candidates to validation, so Recall@10 is not achievable recall for the deployed pipeline. The relative threshold (0.35) means fewer than k candidates may be returned. See production_candidate_recall.

production_candidate_recall.numerator: Ground-truth relevant sections in retrieve_clause_level(translated narrative, min_raw_score=0.0, relative_threshold=0.35, max_k=8), the same call the service makes
production_candidate_recall.denominator: Total ground-truth relevant sections across cases in split
production_candidate_recall.limitations: Upper bound on final recall in fallback mode only when the non-penal gate does not fire.

candidate_precision_at_k_dynamic.numerator: Retrieved candidates in top-k belonging to relevant or plausible target pool
candidate_precision_at_k_dynamic.denominator: Total candidates actually returned by dynamic retriever up to cutoff k

candidate_precision_at_k_fixed.numerator: Retrieved candidates in top-k belonging to relevant or plausible target pool

final_prediction_precision_micro.numerator: Predicted sections belonging to relevant OR plausible candidate pool
final_prediction_precision_micro.denominator: Total sections predicted by engine across all cases
final_prediction_precision_micro.limitations: Lenient: plausible alternatives count as correct for precision but not for recall.

final_prediction_recall_micro.numerator: Ground-truth relevant sections successfully present in engine predictions
final_prediction_recall_micro.denominator: Total ground-truth relevant sections across cases
final_prediction_recall_micro.limitations: Strict: only relevant_candidate_sections count; plausible alternatives are not credited.

final_prediction_f1_micro.averaging: Harmonic mean of micro-precision and micro-recall

macro_metrics.averaging: Macro-averaged equally across all cases regardless of prediction count
macro_metrics.empty_handling: If expected is empty and predicted is empty, case precision=1.0, recall=1.0, F1=1.0. If predicted non-empty on empty expected, precision=0.0, recall=1.0, F1=0.0.

unsupported_section_rate.numerator: Predicted sections not in relevant or plausible label pools
unsupported_section_rate.denominator: Total sections predicted across all cases
unsupported_section_rate.limitations: Not an independent metric: it is the complement of micro precision. 'Unsupported' means absent from the benchmark labels, not legally unsupported by the facts.

contradicted_fp_rate.numerator: Cases where an explicitly contradicted section appeared with score > 0
contradicted_fp_rate.denominator: Cases with at least one explicitly contradicted section defined in benchmark (most list Section 309)

compound_offence_section_recall.numerator: Relevant sections identified across compound multi-offence cases
compound_offence_section_recall.denominator: Total ground-truth relevant sections across evaluated compound cases

compound_case_completion_rate.numerator: Compound offence cases where 100% of expected sections were recovered

non_penal_grievance_gate_fpr.numerator: Genuine penal complaints incorrectly suppressed by grievance gate
non_penal_grievance_gate_fpr.denominator: Evaluated cases with at least one relevant section

non_penal_grievance_gate_fnr_type_c.numerator: Type C non-penal complaints (pricing/career metaphors) where gate failed to activate

non_penal_grievance_gate_fnr_all_zero_se.numerator: Zero-section cases (Type C grievances + Type D vague reports) where gate failed to activate
non_penal_grievance_gate_fnr_all_zero_se.denominator: Evaluated cases with zero expected sections

procedural_correctness_rate_verified_onl.numerator: Cases where the TOP-RANKED prediction's (is_cognizable, is_bailable) equals the labelled pair
procedural_correctness_rate_verified_onl.denominator: Cases with verified_schedule_applicable=true and a non-null expected_cognizable label
procedural_correctness_rate_verified_onl.limitations: Only the top prediction is compared, so a correct classification on a lower-ranked offence scores as a miss. Labels are synthetic; some attempt-case bailability labels carry documented concerns (see cases_with_label_review_notes).
